production.note: US model years. First: 'The First Ever 2019 BMW M2 Competition', which "replaces the BMW M2 Coupe". Last: BMW NA's Model Year 2021 Update Information lists the M2 Competition with "No changes for 2021." (bmw-us-my2021-updates), and Machines With Souls says "The F87 is no longer produced, having ended production in 2021" (mws-f87-m2-buyers-guide). No opened BMW page says in so many words that 2021 was the last model year.

configuration.note: 'inline 6-cylinder engine with M TwinPower Turbo technology' (S55)

fuel.note: Inferred from the release's description of the turbocharged petrol S55 engine.

transmission.note: 'comes standard with a six-speed manual gearbox'; 'The seven-speed M Double Clutch Transmission (M DCT with Drivelogic) can be ordered as an option.'

powerHp.note: Quote: "Engine power hp 405 @ 5,230 – 7,000 405 @ 5,230 – 7,000". Also: "The inline 6-cylinder engine with M TwinPower Turbo technology delivers 405 hp between 5,230 and 7,000 rpm."

weightLb.note: Coupe with the 6-speed manual. Quote: "Curb weight lbs. 3,600 3,655" (columns 'M2 Competition Manual' and 'M2 Competition DCT').

sources.title: The First Ever 2019 BMW M2 Competition (press release with specifications)
